Class ViewLessons

java.lang.Object
guiLessons.ViewLessons
public class ViewLessons extends Object

Title: ViewLessons Class.

Description: Displays the Lessons Learned page using a lazily created, reusable view. Presents lesson fields and a list supporting multiple selections, delegates user actions to ControllerLessons, and loads saved lessons through ModelLessons. Call UI methods on the JavaFX Application Thread. Opening the page saves the current scene and title so the controller can restore them on Back.

Author:
Ahmad El-Merhaby

  • Method Details

    • displayLessons

      public static void displayLessons(javafx.stage.Stage ps, entityClasses.User user)
      Opens the lesson page, creating its widgets on the first call. Saves the stage's current scene and title, displays the user's name, and attempts to reload all lessons belonging to the user before showing the page.
      Parameters:
      ps - the non-null application stage whose current scene is the return page
      user - the non-null user whose username is displayed

    • setupLockButton

      private static void setupLockButton(javafx.scene.control.Button button, double x, double y)
      A simple helper function for setting up the lock buttons. Simplifies a lot of redundant code that would otherwise be repeated each time a new lock button is created.
      Parameters:
      button - the lock button to configure
      x - the horizontal layout position in pixels
      y - the vertical layout position in pixels

    • refreshList

      protected static void refreshList()
      Replaces the displayed list with lessons belonging to the current user and clears the selection and form. Displays an error if loading fails, leaving the existing display unchanged.

      protected static void showLesson(entityClasses.Lesson lesson)
      Copies a lesson's values into the form, or clears all fields for null. Also displays whether a field is locked or not, disabling fields that are locked.
